Comparison with Kato: [Kat04, Theorem 14.2] states, for an eigen cusp form f of weight k_f >= 2 and an integer r with 1 <= r <= k_f - 1 and r != k_f/2, that the Selmer group Sel(K, f, r) is finite for every finite abelian extension K of Q, with no condition on L-values (the condition L(f, chi, k_f/2) != 0 enters only at the centre). Here W tensor chi_cyc^(-k) is attached to a newform f of odd weight 2k+1, and W is irreducible by (3), so W is the Galois representation of f twisted by a critical integer (k or k+1, according to the normalization), which is never central. Finiteness of Sel(Q, f, r) gives H^1_f(Q, W) = 0, and finiteness over the imaginary quadratic field of eta gives H^1_f(Q, W tensor eta) = 0. So the Lean's statement is a special case of Kato's theorem; the hypotheses beyond the attachment to a newform (the level, the shape at l, the residual trace and the windowed condition) are used by Alpöge's Euler system argument and are not needed for Kato's.

In detail: (a) Z.Win.IsAutCsdA is AutCsd0, a CuspSub pi with IsRegAlg, ContraPair.DualIsConj pi (pi^vee isomorphic to pi^c) and Af.AttC (rho o pr is semisimple, IsSSRep, and at cofinitely many finite places w it is unramified with the characteristic polynomial of a geometric Frobenius equal to the product of the X - q_w^((n-1)/2) b over the Satake parameters b of pi_w, the normalization of [BLGGT14, Theorem 2.1.1]), together with WitA, which the deduction does not use. (b) Th.TypeI is U3.MatIrr on V.frame.G', the kernel of eps on G_0, over Qbar_l, and Th.N3 is the density in G' of the elements with separable characteristic polynomial. G' is the image of Gal(Lbar/L(zeta_{l^infinity})), and these two conditions make its image enormous in the sense of [NT23, Definition 2.23] for every coefficient field E over which the characteristic polynomials of the elements of the image split; [NT23, Lemma 2.22 and Section 4.1] work with such an E, after enlarging it. The private Eis.proj, with the inputs RayFin (ray_class_group_finite) and CharPick (exists_character_separation) as hypotheses, which the text proves in its steps (b) and (c). Sd.LocEig, proved by Sd.locEig through the private core. The Lean's mu_1, mu_2 are homomorphisms (E_w)^x -> C^x with no continuity, and the Borel condition is stated for scalar d times aff (a/d) x, the text's matrix with rows (a, dx) and (0, d); the eigenvalue condition is Uop w (Hi.rtr) c Phi = lam Phi, and q is normV w (the card of S in core).

The private gal_of of MPropMHol.lean (a copy is in BaseChangeNorms/PropMHol.lean), stated with the hypothesis hA : Published.GlobalArtinReciprocity, which propMHolZ_alt supplies from HypothesesH' (litN.aut.art); the text cites class field theory [Neu99, Chapter VI] for it, as in the proof of Lemma sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-hilbert-form-exists. UpperTheory.Esk.HolWC, for F totally real with 2 <= finrank Q F, l != 2, iota, D : Wc.LDat F iota, k0 >= 4, c with finite support, c (D.pl v) = 1 for every v, some u with c u != 0 and normV u = 2, omega of finite order, phi and lam with IsEigHol k0 c omega phi lam, TR.IsCuspForm phi and Wc.nu iota (lam (D.pl v)) = 1 for every v, a set S of infinite places and a bound B. The conclusion has t >= B with l - 1 dividing t, and phi', lam' with IsHolV (k0 + 2 (t if v in S else 0)) c omega phi', phi' != 0, TR.IsCuspForm phi', hk k0 w (c w) phi' = lam' w phi' and nu iota ((prod over v of l^t if D.pl v = w and v in S, else 1) lam' w - lam w) < 1 at every prime. The text states it for the map v -> w_v. Every D has D.pl v = w_v by its field embAt, D.pl is a bijection onto the primes above l (inj, surj), and a D exists when every prime above l has norm l and l is not in its square (Wc.exL), which the text assumes; so the product is l^t at the primes w_v with v in S and 1 elsewhere. It is proved by Esk.holWC = holWC_of ..., that is pf_HolWC applied to its inputs; the proof follows pf_HolWC step by step, and its inputs are Lemmas sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-hilbert-form-exists-weight-model-facts, -traces and -linear; the proofs of the first two are open steps, and that of -linear is written out. The text's M_kappa(c, chi) is (mkDat c chi).M kappa and its T_w is the restriction of Dat.Op (aw w) for the representatives aw w of the one-term list [w]; the text's n_s(w) is nz D k0 s w.

The datum mkDat c chi : Dat F (InfinitePlace F) (GF F), with GF F = GL_2 of the finite adeles, sigma v the real embedding at v, j = jF (the diagonal embedding of GL_2(F)), H = Hc c = Kc c sup the scalars (zc), and the height function hf, which the text does not need. Dat.IsForm k f has the fields hol (SepHol: continuity and holomorphy in each variable separately), aut (f(D.act gamma z, D.j gamma x) = D.J k gamma z f(z, x), with D.J the product of the j1 (k v) at the real embeddings), lev and bdd (with nrm k z the product of |Im z_v|^(k_v/2)); M k is the span of these f. P = {z : C // z.im != 0} is the text's C minus R; j1 k g z = den g z^k |det g|^(-k/2), den g z = g_10 z + g_11. Rel k f phi is the text's correspondence, with iP = i. IsReps c W a has the fields act, det and loc of the text; in loc the Lean writes aff (varpi^(count w W)) u for the matrix with first row (varpi^m, u) and second row (0, 1). Dat.Op a is the text's T_a.

Fourteen Prop-valued inputs of pf_HolWC, each proved in the Lean: (1) is H0 (with Sgn k omega: omega.locInf v (-1) = (-1)^(k v), the fixedness under TR.finRep of Kc c and IsChi c omega chi) and the first part of H0b; (2) is HRel (existence, uniqueness of phi, injectivity, linearity, Rel k 0 0, and the translates by Dat.Op a and sums of TR.finRep); (3) is HFin, FormsStableUnderOperators for mkDat c chi with the axioms DAx (Dat.Ax), DReps and the first part of DGood (Good a); (4) is H1; (5) is H2d with H2a (boundedness) and H2e (a bounded holomorphic form is a cusp form); (6) is Wc.HkComm, proved by Wc.hkComm. The Lean's IsChi asks also that every element of Hc c be k z with k in Kc c, which holds by the definition of Hc c. DAx asks for finrank Q F >= 2 and for chi of finite order, which (1) gives. The proof is an open step.

Esk.TrCong, proved by pf_TrCong. The proof is an open step.

Esk.Fin0, proved by finite_system_holds. The Lean's nu is a Valuation on C with values in the nonnegative reals, the text's multiplicative absolute value with the ultrametric inequality; the Lean's l.Prime and nu l < 1 are the text's hypotheses on l, and its families are indexed by a type J with decidable equality. The text's s is the Lean's function s : J -> C, and its S_0 the Lean's cong.

Esk.Sys, proved by pf_Sys. The Lean's S is a Finset (J -> C) and m a function (J -> C) -> N, with (1) stated as the equivalence of s in S with the existence of f != 0 and T j f = s j f for every j; the text's m(u) is the dimension of the joint generalized eigenspace E(u), CommutingOperatorTraces.E.

Fin0Aux.nat_le_one (1), Fin0Aux.step (2), Fin0Aux.iter (3) and Fin0Aux.prod_near_one (4), each for a Valuation nu on C with values in the nonnegative reals; prod_near_one is stated for a list of complex numbers. step and iter take l prime, and iter also nu l < 1, as in the text.

Fin0Aux.factors, for a linear form Lambda on (J -> C) -> C, a predicate P on lists of J closed under appending one element, and a list Fs of triples (alpha, j, beta). Proved by induction on Fs, as in the text.
Fin0Aux.integral, with a : (J -> C) -> C, of which only the values on S enter, and the sum written through Fin0Aux.lam S a. The text's c(x) is the Lean's c, and its K the Lean's K.

UpperTheory.Esk.HRep, for F totally real, k >= 2, t : InfinitePlace F -> N (the text's n), c, omega of finite order, and phi with IsHolV (k + 2 t v) c omega phi, phi != 0, hk k w (c w) phi = lam w phi and TR.IsCuspForm phi. The conclusion is pi : TR.CuspSub F 2 with IsRegAlg, Polarized chi for some chi, HasInfChar v (infOf (t v, 1 - k - t v)) at every infinite place, HasU w (pi.locRep w) (c w) (lam w) at every prime, and, where c w = 0, HasSat w B with the product of X - algSat b equal to X^2 - lam w X + omega.val w normV w^(k - 1). It is proved by Esk.pf_HRep_alt from HypothesesH' and Esk.HCap (s_HCap); the assumption on Galois representations stands for HypothesesH'. The proof follows pf_HRep_alt step by step. It uses three fields of HypothesesH' that are published results: the discreteness of the cuspidal spectrum (Published.CuspSemisimpleReal, a cusp form on which the central direction of the Lie algebra acts by a scalar lies in the sum of the cuspidal representations; cited to [GGPS69]), Gelfand and Kazhdan's description of the contragredient (Published.GelfandKazhdanReal, a nondegenerate pairing between pi and its composite with the transpose inverse; cited to [GK75]) and strong multiplicity one (Published.StrongMultOneReal, two cuspidal representations of GL_a over a totally real field with the same Satake parameters at almost all primes are isomorphic; cited to [JS81b]). The Satake parameters of step (6) come from exists_sat_alt, which repeats the argument of locTrans (Lemma sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-hilbert-form-galois-component(1)) from the published admissibility and the Satake isomorphism of the bundle; the eigenvalues of the double cosets are the field of IsSatVecGL, read through sat_two. The text's polarizing character chi is omega nu^2 with nu = Model.absPow F (1 - k/2). The text's Capelli invariance in step (7) is cited to [HU91]; the Lean proves it (GlobalTheory.CapAdInv.qdet_semiconj and qdet_ad, TR.cap_comm).

Esk.HCap, proved by pf_HCap (PfHCap.lean), with sign_hol (PfHRep.lean) for (3). The text's X is TR.lie F 2 (TR.oneL F 2), the derivative in the direction of the identity matrix at every infinite place, and X^v_ab is TR.Eop v (a - 1) (b - 1). HCap states (2) for TR.cap v u, which is Formalism.REAL.qdet (TR.Eop v) (u + 1/2), the Capelli column determinant (s + E_00)(s - 1 + E_11) - E_10 E_01 of the text's C_v(s). The Lean's HasInfChar v m is the statement that cap v u acts by the product of the u + z, z in m, on the space of the representation, and infOf (m_1, m_2) is the multiset of the 1/2 + m_i; the text's infinitesimal character of weight (m_1, m_2) is this one. HCap states (1) only for X; the text adds X^v_11 + X^v_22, which pf_HCap proves as h0 by lie_scalar with Pi.single v 1. The computation of (2) is the private casimir (UpperTheory.Reformulated.B.Qf10.casimir), a linear combination of the commutation relations and of the hypotheses; the text arranges it through H, Y and W. (3) is stated in the Lean as omega.locInf v (-1) = exp(i pi kappa(v)).

UpperTheory.Esk.HeckeRepresentationSatake.proj (PfHRep.lean), a public copy of the private proj of HolRep.lean. The stable spaces are those with TR.IsStable: stable under TR.act o for every o : TR.Op F 2, that is fin (GL_2 of the finite adeles), cpt (TR.Kinf, the unitary group of E tensor R) and lie (the Lie algebra). The Lean states the hypothesis as membership in the supremum of the spaces of all TR.CuspSub F 2 and asks for z with z V contained in V for every stable V.

(1) is Sd.OrdIrr, proved by Sd.ordinary_irreducible_of_printed_hida from HypothesesH'; (2) is Sd.OrdAway, proved by Z.Win.RR.ordAway_a_alt (RR.ordAway_of_alt); (3) is Sd.OrdAbove, proved by Z.Win.RR.ordAbove_of_printsH (RR.ordAbove_of_alt); (4) is Z.Win.Birth.PrOrd, proved by prOrd through ordPlain. The Lean states OrdAway and PrOrd without the assumptions that l is odd and that the primes above l have norm l, and PrOrd without HypothesesH'. The book cites (2) and (3) to Carayol [Car86] and Wiles [Wil88, Theorem 2.1.4], results for Hilbert modular forms that the Lean does not cite, here in the normalization of the ordinary form datum. The Lean proves them its own way, from the local-global compatibility of the Galois representations of Gal.SV.exRS_alt, with local_comp_real_of_printed_results, jacqOfU_alt and isSubquotient_principalSeries_of_borel_functional, in about 26,000 lines with their dependencies (about 6,400 for RR.ordAway_a_alt and 26,400 for RR.ordAbove_of_printsH, overlapping); the book does not follow that proof. Lemma sha-automorphy-ordinary-forms, the case E = Q of (1) to (3), cites the same two results for its parts (2) and (3), which the Lean proves through the same RR.ordAway_of_alt and RR.ordAbove_of_alt. The proof of (1) follows ordinary_irreducible_of_printed_hida: chars_of_red, hom_or, Af.algOfCyc_s (the algebraic Hecke character, [Ser68, Chapter III]), Gal.SV.ratioW_of_hasSat_alt with GalN.V.ratio_roots for the window, GalN.V.type_zero_window, Corev.UnrPow.exists_pow_unrAt and cyc_ine. The proof of (4) follows prOrd and ordPlain step by step, with pi itself as the representation (PR is a TR.CuspSub with IsRegAlg, AttR and PlainR, and PlainR asks, at every finite place, PlainAtR, that every local component be PlainTor, or HasSat). It uses Lemmas sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-hilbert-form-galois-jacquet (uLoc), sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-hilbert-form-galois-component (locTrans) and sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-hilbert-form-galois-central (detCent), with psCent (the centre acts on prinSeries psi by psi 0 psi 1) and psPlain (the support of a subquotient of prinSeries psi is the characters psi i, by IwahoriSupport.hasSupport_chars, and psi i = psi j nu translates into equality on the units and psi i(unif) normV = psi j(unif)) for steps (iii) and (iv), and the private real_core and norm_q of OrdPlain.lean for step (v).

Z.Win.Birth.ULoc, proved by uLoc, for a number field F and w : Pl F. HasU w sigma.rho c lam is the existence of a nonzero vector fixed by Sd.K1 w c with Sd.Uop eigenvalue lam. The principal series is IsSubquotient sigma.rho (prinSeries psi), the normalized induction indB of torusChar psi, which the text writes psi_0 x psi_1; the triviality of psi_0 on the units is IsUnitAt w x -> psi 0 x = 1, and the relation is lam^2 = normV w psi 0 (unif w)^2. The proof follows uLoc: its first part is the private jacq, a copy of Sd.jacqOfU (whose statement Sd.JacqOfU is the existence of mu_1, mu_2 and the form L of step (7)) without the hypothesis bundle that jacqOfU takes and does not use; its second part is the private ps_of_form. The coset sum of step (1) is Sd.uopSum. Frobenius reciprocity is GlobalTheory.SatakeExists.isSubquotient_of_eigenform, which the Lean proves through Model.evalOne_bijective and the text cites to [BZ77]; it gives an embedding of sigma into the principal series, of which the statement keeps the subquotient.

Z.Win.Birth.LocTrans, proved by locTrans (LocTransAlt.lean), for pi : TR.CuspSub F 2 over a totally real F. The text's pi_w is pi.locRep w, and a local component is pi.IsLocComp w sigma. (1) is HasFixed (pi.locRep w) (K1 w 0) -> exists B, pi.HasSat w B; (2) is HasU w (pi.locRep w) c lam -> HasU w sigma.rho c lam; (3) is stated for any omega : HChar F with the central relation on the forms of pi. The proof follows locTrans: the isotypy is the private RealLocalComponent.isotypic (LocCompR.lean), through bot_or_top and the irreducibility of pi under GL_2 of the finite adeles, TR.Kinf and the Lie algebra; (1) uses RealLocalComponent.exists_comp, which rests on the published admissibility Published.AdmissibleReal, then CuspRep.LocSph.exists_fixed_of_mem_iSup and the private Nf.satLoc' (SatInd.exists_hasSatGL_of_isIrreducible for the Satake parameters of a spherical representation, cited to [Car79]); (2) is the private Wc.sep_of_sum and hasU_of_map with Wc.hkReps; (3) is scalar_fin and CuspRep.scalar_comm.

Z.Win.Birth.DetCent, proved by detCent, for AttR iota r pi, det r = cycBar^s xi, IsOpen ker xi and any omega : HChar F with the central relation on the forms of pi. (1) is the existence of N > 0 with (omega.loc w (unif w) normV w^(s+1))^N = 1, and (2) is the implication from the triviality of omega.loc w on the units to Ine A <= ker xi for every A over w. The proof follows detCent. The Hecke character chi of xi is HeckeGal.exists_unique_hchar_of_finite_order, for the global Artin map of GlobalTheory.globalArtinReciprocity_holds; the text cites class field theory [Neu99, Chapter VI], and the properties of chi in step (a) are IsLAdicOf.frob_unr and IsLAdicOf.unr_iff. Step (b) is scalar_eq_prod (the scalar matrix as a Hecke operator, with eigenvalue satEig for j = 2, the product of B) and det_sat (algSat); step (c) is PositivityTheory.jumpWindows.FiniteInfinitePlaceProduct.eq_one, whose density input GroundTheory.Global.denseRange_units_prod_pi is weak approximation, cited to [Neu99, Chapter II, 3].

(1) is the private attR_tw_cyc of MixSeed.lean in BaseChangeNorms (a copy is in DenseRangeUnitsR.lean), stated for GL_n: pi' is pi.twist (Model.absPow F k), and AttR is AttachedSys with HasSat, semisimplicity and the match of Satake parameters with Frobenius eigenvalues at almost all primes. The proofs follow the Lean.

The private ordAt_tw of MixSeed.lean (BaseChangeNorms), for any place A over any prime w; the text takes w above l, as in Definition sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-datum(1). The hypotheses are the Lean's: continuity of r and psi_0, l - 1 dividing s, m_0 and k, det r = cycBar^s psi_0 psi_1, |psi_i| = 1, Ine A in ker psi_0, IsFlagOn r (Dec A) kappa, kappa_i = cycBar^(m_i) on Ine A, and the congruence at the Frobenius elements (IsFrob). U is the private subgroup U1 of MixSeed.lean. The proof follows the Lean.

UpperTheory.V.Sd.sIabs, the proof of Sd.SIabs, for any group Gamma with IsIrr rho, ResSum rho ![1, Phi] and a normal subgroup H containing an element whose characteristic polynomial is separable. The private irrOpen_of of MixSeed.lean (BaseChangeNorms), for a number field F with algebraic closure Omega, IsIrr r, ResSum r ![1, xi], a place A with A.valuation l < 1 and OrdAt r ![k, 0] psi A. sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-ribet: exists_ribet_lattice proves Sd.S2.RibOf: for Hyp, CharDat and MixDat for r, and u in G_{k0} mapping to (g_0^T)^2, there is r' with RepIso r r', r' u 0 1 = r' u 1 0 = 0, Rib (r' h) (xi h) for h in G_{k0} cap G_F, and ||r' h 0 1|| = 1 for some such h.
sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-ribet-latt: V.Sd.ribetLat proves V.Sd.RibetLat, for a compact Hausdorff topological group Gamma, with ResSum rho ![a, b] for the congruence of the characteristic polynomials, IsIrr rho for irreducibility, Cong for the congruence, and RepIso rho rho' for the conjugation by P. sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-irreducibl: induced_irreducible proves Sd.S2.IndIrr: IsIrr of R composed with resQ T.F, restricted to T.G' = T.GalL inf ker cycZ.

V.U3.exists_selfTwist, for kappa algebraically closed of characteristic 0, H normal with every commutator in H, MatIrr top and not MatIrr H; the conclusion MatIso top (phi rho) rho is the matrix Q with Q (eta(g) r(g)) = r(g) Q. V.Sd.irrAb proves V.Sd.IrrAb: Continuous r and IrrOpen r (irreducible on every open subgroup), H open, H' <= H containing the commutators of elements of H, conclude IsIrr on H'.

V.AlgebraTools.mackeyTwo, for a Representation of G on a k-module V (no finiteness is assumed), with StableOn for stability and IrrOn rho top for the conclusion, which says only that the stable subspaces are 0 and V. It is the case of index 2 of Mackey's irreducibility criterion (Serre, Linear representations of finite groups, Section 7.4, Proposition 23, for finite groups), proved directly for any group.

mix_invariant_plane_decomposition proves Sd.S2.MixIrr: for IsMix j t alpha beta rho R (which includes 2 != 0, j injective with range of index 2, t not in the range, rho(u) = diag(alpha^2, beta^2) for j u = t t, and the forms of R on the range and at t), U not contained in the range, IsIrr of rho on the preimage of U, and no M conjugating rho to rho(t^-1 . t) there, R is irreducible on U. residual_characters_psi_ne proves Sd.S2.PsiNe: from D.Good, T.Ok and T.Two (the conditions (a) to (r)), some g in T.G' has T.rb wPs g != 1, where T.rb wPs is the residue of chi^(0,1). The field k_0 of (2) is the one of Tower.Two.quad, which is condition (p).
sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-flags: induced_flag_condition proves Sd.S2.IndFlag, with m = (k + t, k, 0, -t) in the Lean's names (j + t, j, 0, -t in the text). The matrix n is LowQ: IsLow, entries of norm at most 1, ||n 2 1|| < 1 and ||n 2 0|| = 1, the entries (3,2) and (3,1) of the text.
sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-flags-line: mix_stable_line_local proves Sd.S2.LocLine, for a family A of elements of GL_2 indexed by a type S, with Rib (A s) (x s) for the conditions on entries and S2.Flag A kappa for the matrix P (the Lean's flag matrix g conjugates A s to an upper triangular matrix with diagonal kappa 0 s, kappa 1 s). sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-flags-matr: mix_flag_exists proves Sd.S2.MixFlag: for l odd, ||gamma|| = 1, ||u|| <= 1 and ||w|| < 1 (y in the text), there are n with LowQ n for each of the two cases, which are the private nn (gamma u) (-1) (gamma u) (-(2w)/(1 + gamma u w)) (-(1 - gamma u w)/(1 + gamma u w)) and nn (-u) 1 u (-(2w)/(gamma + u w)) ((gamma - u w)/(gamma + u w)); the Lean states only the existence of n, and the text names the two matrices of its proof. sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-deletion: induced_deletion_condition proves Sd.S2.IndDel; the condition delta(s) = 1 is asked when cycZ s = 1, the Z_l-valued cyclotomic character, which is the text's chi_cyc(s) = 1.
sha-siegel-step-seeds-induced-local: GalN.V.indLoc0: exists n with LocOk T (twF T R delta, n) (which is (b) of Lemma sha-siegel-step-seeds-final), m with the gaps, b, N with Wts0 (the same as Tower.Wts, inertial weights) for 2m + b, 0 < N and the identity for delta. sha-stickelberger-elements: thetaEl, yEl and ytEl, with sumEl phi f = sum over b of f(b) times [phi(b)^(-1)]. The proofs apply them with phi = (piQ rho)^(-1), so that [phi(b)^(-1)] is sigma_b as in the text. Eone M a b = (a-1)/2 - jv M a b, where jv M a b = (a <a^(-1) b> - <b>)/M is the floor in the text, and ytEl = -sum of <b>^e Eone(b) sigma_b.
sha-stickelberger-annihilator: zKill, applied in killPow with N l in place of N and a = 2 N l + 1. The hypothesis on l is Procyc. Step 1 is Kum.resInfInj; Step 2 is resKill, through Kum.xdualExt, homKill and clKill, and Stickelberger's theorem itself is proved in the Lean (UpperTheory.V.Stick, through Jacobi sums); Step 3 is Odd.congr through near_level, with ck l (k+1) the valuation c of the text; Step 4 is totKill.
sha-stickelberger-determinant: Part (a) is B5.algebraMap_signedInvolutionQuotientDet_mem_span with Odd.adjKill; detR c eps z is the determinant of the matrix mat c eps z on the coset representatives Qc c. Part (b) is det_mul_quotientByOrderTwo_eq_prod_charEval. Part (c) is higherStickelberger_det_exists_int_bounded, with d = denY M (k+1) and s = sizeY M a (k+1); the nonvanishing is groupRingCharEval_stickelbergerY_ne_zero_of_parity and the size bound norm_charEval_higherStickelberger_le. Odd.detVal draws the consequence used in Lemma sha-minus-exponent.
sha-torsion-length: Odd.gen, with F = Fn E Omega l 1 (fnOne), unrInj (restriction of l-torsion classes to G_F), unrSel (Kummer theory), selCard (the order l^(2m) h_F) and logH. The class number bound is KStar.IdealCounting.log_classNumber_le, and the discriminant bound is Odd.logDisc, from the conductor-discriminant formula.
sha-iwasawa-module: X'_infinity(L) is Tower.XP l L = XN l L (AlgebraicClosure L) l = Xinf l l top, the Z_l-dual of Dinf: locally constant homomorphisms on cycU l top (the subgroup with trivial cyclotomic character) vanishing on all inertia groups and on the decomposition groups at places dividing l. xTw e twists the dual action by cycZ^e. The description as a Galois group is class field theory and is not stated in the Lean.
sha-iwasawa-descent: PropA.descends, proved by Tower.step0: shaInv L1 l e = cokerLen ((xTw e gamma)^(l^m) - 1). The identification with invariants is Tower.desc (inflation-restriction), the invariants are described by shaDGen, and Pontryagin duality is cokerDual.
sha-cokernel-growth: PropA.growth, with Unip g the existence of n with (g - 1)^n X contained in l X. The steps are unipPow ((g-1)^R X in l X), frob, powIn and step (one more power of l adds at most R).
sha-exceptional-centres: PropA.exists_centres_level, from lift (the matrix S), detFactor (eigenvalues in the completed algebraic closure PadicAlgCl l), ball (the centre s_i, through helly and the identity of lteNorm) and normVal. IsLevel u c is the condition on u.
sha-tower-from-module: PropA.aBound_of_isTower: IsTower l L R (L totally complex, mu_l or mu_4 in L, R >= 1, XP generated by R elements) gives ABound l R L. In ABound the text takes K = Q_l, R' = R and c = cZero l L; gamma comes from genLevel. Condition (ii) uses shaLeV, whose hypotheses Poitou-Tate duality, local finiteness and local Tate duality are proved results.
sha-kummer-layers: Lay, EqHom, nrm, Few, gens and tc of UpperTheory.V.ZK. EqHom gamma a q is a set of functions on HeightOneSpectrum; its description as homomorphisms from the class group is a reformulation in the text. tc L N m is the order of the torsion subgroup of groupHomology of GL_N(O_L) with trivial coefficients Z.
sha-control: UpperTheory.V.Base.control states injectivity of restriction from U to cycU l U on the Selmer groups (selRes for shaFam), identifies the image with the U-invariants, and also allows l = 2 when U lies in the subgroup gamU (controlGamma). The text states injectivity on all of H^1, which is what the argument gives; only the Selmer case is used.
sha-bar-chains: Ch A G m is the free A-module on functions Fin m -> G; bd is the boundary of inhomogeneous chains with trivial coefficients (shown equal to Mathlib's groupHomology.inhomogeneousChains.d), cm is f_*, prism k is h_k with c_k = MulAut.conj k^(-1), Cyc and Bd are cycles and boundaries. zc q e is z_{q,e}, with the generator 1 of ZMod q in the odd positions, and dt q t is Delta_t.
sha-bar-identities: The four parts are SChain (with the trivial-group case as its last component), SPrism, SPrismMul and SZc. SPrism and SPrismMul are proved through the homogeneous model (toInh, hprism, conj_toInh in ToInhPartialProd, and the cone operators hd of SPrismMul); SZc is the direct computation first_face and merge described in the text.
sha-bar-relation: SRel, proved by LateralTheory.Q.SRelT.SRel_of: gen_two bounds the number of generators of H_{2e+2}(Z/q x Z/q; Z/q) by 2e+3 through step (the exact sequence with tr and trIso, Shapiro's lemma through Rep.coind) and gen_cyc; Gen.rel and rel_bd produce the relation. The coefficients are elements of ZMod (l^nu) with n t0 a unit.
sha-eta: SEta, proved by sEta in ExpStep: exp_cong, exp_step and exp_dvd are Step 1, nat_dvd, diff_dvd and sgl_dvd Step 2, and the formula for eta is that of the text, read off as Finsupp coefficients of an element of AddMonoidAlgebra Z (ZMod q x ZMod q).
sha-additive-family: Fam k A m is a family of A-linear maps on Ch A (V equiv_k V) m for all finite k-modules V; IsAdd records bdry, iso (for cj phi, on cycles) and add (for sumRep, on cycles). HasVal q e zeta v theta is the value condition, with chi q zeta x the character a -> zeta^(x a) and scal V the scalars. IsPrimFam has bdry, stab (for the upper-left inclusion stab R n n') and psi (for the Kronecker block sum psi R d n).
sha-transfer: STrans, proved by UpperTheory.V.ZK.Trans.main. The transfer is tr with term, la (the right action on Projectivization) and lc (the cocycle from a homogeneous function lam); IsCoc.tr_bd is the chain-map property, tr_cob and indep the independence of lam, theta_iso, theta_one and theta_add the three properties, with card_inl and card_inr the fibre counts.
sha-cocycle: SCoc, proved by sCoc in FProd: ex_log gives lambda and r, F is the cup product, F_coc shows that it vanishes on boundaries, F_ins computes the alternating sum over insertions, and F_prod writes it as a product.
sha-theta: STheta, obtained by sThetaOf from SChain, SPrism, SPrismMul, SZc, STrans and SCoc. The homomorphism property is hmul (from SPrismMul), and the reduction to the determinant is fam_det, which uses gl_hom_transvection_eq_one_of_ne_zero_of_ne_one with a = zeta.
sha-primitive: SPhi, proved by sPhi in PiRepApply, with val_one (trivial representations), val_iso and val_pi (block sums).
sha-steinitz: SStein, proved by LateralTheory.Q.SSteinT.SStein_of through rel_scale, rel_move (with exists_sl2_with_valuation_bounds) and rel_of_sum_eq. Divisors are finitely supported functions on HeightOneSpectrum, and Lambda(a) is the condition P.valuation (x j) <= exp(-a j P). This is a form of Steinitz's theorem on direct sums of ideals, proved in the Lean.
sha-detect: SDetect, proved by LateralTheory.Q.SDetectCut.goal from GlobalTheory.Published.ChebotarevDegreeOne (Theorem lit-chebotarev-degree-one) through its density form; frob_fix is the computation with the Frobenius. sha-class-cycle: SClass, obtained by sClassOf = cJoin from the lemmas CChain (Step 5), CFree and CInt (Step 6), CTriv, CAct, CSplit (Step 1, the element b0), CSupp (the element b), CLatLoc and CRep (Step 4), CMu (the reduction mu), CVal with CBlockVal, CBlock and CMat (the evaluation on blocks), CGtNe and CGtEq (Step 3, from SStein), CBetaDiv (the divisor of beta), CBetaVal (the final sum) and CUnit (the map f). The Lean's g_t are L-linear automorphisms of F^J, Carries records the block form, and the twist for t0 is T(chi_j)^(-1) with T(kappa^i) = gamma^i. In the statement the residue condition is Res r (nrm gamma a alpha) u and the value is pe (1+l^c) (2e+3) (e+1) times v u.
sha-borel-rank: BOdd. Cited to Borel; the Lean does not cite Borel for it and proves it itself as PositivityTheory.KB.bOdd_zk, from bStarOdd through sBStarOdd_of, in about 34,000 lines under LiteratureResults/KTheoryStability. That proof has the shape of the deduction given after the theorem: it builds real cocycles on GL_N(O_L) from invariant differential forms (sHecke, sWhit, sCen, sStokes_of and others), shows that a non-boundary cycle in the stable range is detected by such a cocycle (sSep, sSurj, sStab), decomposes each cocycle into r_2(L) functionals tau_w, one for each infinite place, and components a_j of weights 2 <= j <= k+1 (sWtOdd_of), and checks that the sequence z_t kills the components a_j (wsys_zc). Borel's theorem computes the stable real cohomology; the rank bound for the classes z_k follows from it with van der Kallen's stability theorem and the Milnor-Moore theorem, as in the text. zSeq is the sequence z_t, with lev l n t = l^t n; the hypothesis n >= 2k+6 is 2(k+1)+4 <= n.
sha-few-values: SUpper, obtained by sUpperOf from SChain and BOdd through selmer_upper_bound_of_inputs with torsStab (Step 1), descend and zVal (Step 2), bock, rankCount and fibCount (Step 3). TorsStab uses UpperTheory.V.Published.KStability, which the Lean states as a published theorem and also proves (GlobalTheory.HomStab.kStability_main) for rings of stable rank 2, in the range n >= 2m + 4; van der Kallen's theorem gives a larger range.
sha-few-norms: SFew, obtained by LateralTheory.Q.SFewOfCut.sFewOf from STheta, SPhi, SClass, SUpper and SDetect. prim_map gives the primitive root modulo P, exists_index the homomorphism v_P, pe_dvd (through not_dvd_sub and not_dvd_pow_sub_one) the divisibility of p_e, and isPrimFam_pi the product family.
sha-count-homs: SCount, proved by sCount through the datum Ct.Dat with W, EQ and ClQ as in the text: lte (the valuations), cardEQ (the unit computation, through places, UnitLat, LatDet and PermDet), cardW, eqHomLe, kerF, fewLe, pCount, selInj, selInvLe (Hilbert 90, through selInvLe_lemma_5) and selLCard. The Lean's W is the quotient of U by the intersection with range(g - a) plus torsion, as in the text.
sha-kummer-descent: SSha, proved by PositivityTheory.QuaternionShaBounds.sSha = ShaAsm_holds LayEx_holds ClInj_holds. LayEx constructs the Kummer layer Kum.Fn L Omega l nu with a lift g of gamma and cycR g = 1 + l^c; ClInj is the injection of l^nu-torsion class-group homomorphisms into EqHom; resInfInj and resInfMem are the restriction to U_infinity, and good_of and card_le the passage to a finite level. The hypothesis on L is TopRoot l c L.
sha-enlarging: SLayer, proved by LateralTheory.Q.SLayerCut.goal_of with m = Nat.clog l (4E+4) and L' = layF l L Omega m; disc_cyc is the discriminant bound through the different, Win.rootdeg the bound l^c <= 2[L':Q], and sha_le the monotonicity through exists_descends (Lemma sha-iwasawa-descent). The hypothesis HasMuQ l L is that L contains mu_l, or mu_4 if l = 2.
sha-gl-torsion: STors, proved by sTors from torsAll with C = 24. torsAll applies KT.tors_le, which is KH.mainFace (Lemma sha-torsion-from-action for the face complex, with b = m+2) for the complex Sx L N of Lemma sha-hermitian-polyhedron, with exactness sx_exact, orbit bound orbBound (KT.orb) and stabilizer bound 3^(dd N) (KT.stab); TorsLe.log_le_exp and TorsionExponentBound.exponent_le give the final estimate. tc L N m is the order of the torsion of groupHomology of GL_N(O_L) with trivial coefficients Z.
sha-convex-nerve: UpperTheory.V.ConeExtensionAcyclic.nerve_convex. The nerve nerve X A n is the set of maps Fin n -> I with a common point in X, so N_p(X) of the text is nerve X A (p+1), and Acyc is exactness of the augmented complex (with Ch I 0 = Z for the empty tuple). Step 1 is acyc_cone, Step 2 is nerve_compact (by strong induction on the number of faces, with nerve_sep for the separating form, nerve_cut for the decomposition and acyc_union for the Mayer-Vietoris step), and Step 3 is acyc_directed. This is a form of the nerve theorem for closed convex covers (Borsuk, Leray), proved directly.
sha-polyhedron-nerve: UpperTheory.V.ConeExtensionAcyclic.acyc_simp applied to Good q T: the fields locFin, nonempty, closed, smul_mem, sub and pos are the hypotheses of the text, poly q is P, posDual T is T^*, IsVert is the vertex condition and normalCone the normal cone. The steps are dual_convex (convexity), sublevel (compact sublevel sets), vert_finite (finitely many vertices in a compact set), exists_vert with perturb (covering) and cone_finite (finiteness); acyc_simp also records that the nerve is closed under faces and that every 0-tuple occurs.
sha-hermitian-polyhedron: HS L N is the space of tuples of Hermitian matrices indexed by InfinitePlace L (all complex, as L is totally complex), q h y = qR h (toR y) is q_y(h), Ry L N = poly (qc L N) is P, Psd L N is T, Vx L N are the vertices and Sx L N p the tuples X_p; the action of GL_N(O_L) is the MulAction on these types. Part (a) is KT.good (from psdcone, ryne, rypos and locfin) with sx_exact. Part (b) is KT.stab: stabfin (finiteness, through the minimal vectors) and mink3 (a finite subgroup of the units of a ring free of rank r over Z has at most 3^r elements). Part (c) is KT.orb with orbBound = I0^(1 + dd N) ((2 RR + 1)^dd + 1)^(dd N (p+1)), I0 = |d_L|^N dd^dd and RR = N^N I0^2 (dd = nN = D): the matrix A is sx_basis, the norm bound is nrmle (Hadamard through hadam, and detlow), the Hermite normal form count is hnf through hnfone, the vertices near A are nearvx through nearvec and vxdet, and orbnum is the final numerical estimate.
sha-torsion-from-action: UpperTheory.V.KH.main for a complex of permutation representations (PermCx), proved by KH.shift by induction on m: the base case is KH.base (torsion of the coinvariants, b^A), the permutation modules are KH.permCard (by induction on the number of orbits, with permTrans through Shapiro's lemma and finGroup), and the extension step is KH.torsStep. TorsLe M B says that the torsion subgroup of M is finite of order at most B; bound m A s b = b^A s^(m A s^m). KH.mainFace is the special case of a face complex, where b = m+2.
